label: main-261adc2
features_vs_v0_2_0: POST /play and /play/<pose> — stream a 16-bit mono 22050 Hz WAV while an animation runs
PUT /settings/wifi — up to 5 saved networks, migrated from the single wifi_ssid/wifi_pass pair
POST /servos/park — park joints and hold PWM (used before flashing)
web UI rebuilt in Preact/TypeScript, embedded gzipped in the app
route table with explicit access levels (Public / Token / Configured / Setup)

flash.usb: pio run -t upload (the post-script also uploads the filesystem)
flash.partition_note: partitions.csv keeps nvs at 0x9000/0x5000, so servo calibration, token and WiFi survive. Do not use -t erase.
flash.ota_caveat: the [env:ota] table moves LittleFS to 0x310000 — reflash the filesystem too, or the UI/assets disappear
